lead_story: The US Treasury yields are falling due to hopes of de-escalation with Iran and lower oil prices, the dollar is also experiencing its worst week in over 3 months, and the Fed is facing pressure to act on inflation, which is currently at its lowest in years, causing uncertainty in the market, the joint action on the yen between Tokyo and Washington is also being closely watched
